childMax);\n270\t            }\n271\t        }\n272\t    }\n273\t\n274\tpublic:\n275\t    // Check if a ray intersects this node's bounding box\n276\t    bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) const {\n277\t        Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n278\t        Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n279\t        Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};\n280\t\n281\t        if (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n282\t        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n283\t        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n284\t\n285\t        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n286\t        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n287\t        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n288\t\n289\t        return true;\n290\t    }\n291\t\n292\t    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n293\t    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n294\t    template<typename Func>\n295\t    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n296\t        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n297\t        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {\n298\t            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {\n299\t                if (func(idx, (*allTriangles)[idx])) return true;\n300\t            }\n301\t            return false;\n302\t        }\n303\t\n304\t        // Otherwise, descend to children\n305\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n306\t            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n307\t                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;\n308\t            }\n309\t        }\n310\t        return false;\n311\t    }\n312\t};\n313\t\n314\t// ============================================================================\n315\t// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n316\t// ============================================================================\n317\t\n318\t// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\n319\tclass IcosphereMesh {\n320\tpublic:\n321\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n322\t\n323\t    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n324\t        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n325\t        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n326\t\n327\t        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n328\t            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n329\t            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n330\t            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n331\t            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n332\t            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n333\t            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n334\t            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n335\t            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n336\t            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n337\t            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n338\t            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n339\t            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n340\t        };\n341\t\n342\t        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n343\t        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n344\t            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n345\t            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n346\t            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n347\t            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n348\t        };\n349\t\n350\t        // Subdivide\n351\t        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n352\t            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n353\t            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n354\t\n355\t            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n356\t                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n357\t                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n358\t                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n359\t\n360\t                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n361\t                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n362\t                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n363\t                vertices.push_back(mid);\n364\t                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n365\t                return idx;\n366\t            };\n367\t\n368\t            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n369\t                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n370\t                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n371\t                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n372\t\n373\t                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n374\t                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n375\t                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n376\t                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n377\t            }\n378\t            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n379\t        }\n380\t\n381\t        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n382\t        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n383\t        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n384\t            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n385\t            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n386\t        }\n387\t    }\n388\t};\n389\t\n390\t// ============================================================================\n391\t// Random Number Generation\n392\t// ============================================================================\n393\t\n394\tclass RandomGenerator {\n395\t    std::mt19937 rng;\n396\t    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\n397\tpublic:\n398\t    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n399\t    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n400\t};\n401\t\n402\t// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n403\tVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n404\t    val_t u = rng.rand();\n405\t    val_t v = rng.rand();\n406\t    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n407\t        u = 1.0f - u;\n408\t        v = 1.0f - v;\n409\t    }\n410\t    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n411\t    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n412\t    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n413\t}\n414\t\n415\t// ============================================================================\n416\t// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n417\t// ============================================================================\n418\t\n419\tval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n420\t                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n421\t    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n422\t    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n423\t    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n424\t    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n425\t\n426\t    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n427\t\n428\t    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n429\t    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n430\t    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n431\t    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432\t\n433\t    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434\t    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435\t    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n436\t\n437\t    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n438\t}\n439\t\n440\t// ============================================================================\n441\t// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n442\t// ============================================================================\n443\t\n444\t// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n445\t// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\n446\tbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n447\t                  const Octree& octree,\n448\t                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n449\t    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n450\t    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n451\t    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n452\t    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n453\t\n454\t    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n455\t        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n456\t\n457\t        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n458\t        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n459\t            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n460\t        }\n461\t        return false;\n462\t    });\n463\t}\n464\t\n465\t// ============================================================================\n466\t// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n467\t// ============================================================================\n468\t\n469\t// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n470\tval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n471\t    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n472\t    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n473\t    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n474\t}\n475\t\n476\t// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n477\tval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n478\t                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n479\t                  const Octree& octree,\n480\t                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481\t    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482\t    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483\t\n484\t    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485\t    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486\t\n487\t    val_t kij = ZERO;\n488\t\n489\t    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490\t        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491\t        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492\t\n493\t        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494\t\n495\t        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n496\t        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n497\t        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n498\t\n499\t        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n500\t        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501\t\n502\t        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503\t\n504\t        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505\t    }\n506\t\n507\t    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n508\t}\n509\t\n510\t// ============================================================================\n511\t// Tau (time delay) Computation\n512\t// ============================================================================\n513\t\n514\tint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n515\t    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n516\t    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\t// ============================================================================\n520\t// Room Response Simulation State\n521\t// ============================================================================\n522\t\n523\tstruct SimulationState {\n524\t    size_t numTriangles;\n525\t    size_t numTimesteps;\n526\t\n527\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n528\t    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n529\t    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n530\t    std::vector<val_t> state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n553\t    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n554\t    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n555\t    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n556\t\n557\t    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n558\t\n559\t    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n560\t ZERO);\n578\t\n579\t    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n580\t    size_t timeOn = 0;\n581\t    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n582\t    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n583\t        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n584\t    }\n585\t}\n586\t\n587\t// ============================================================================\n588\t// Precomputation Phase\n589\t// ============================================================================\n590\t\n591\tvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n592\t    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n593\t    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n594\t\n595\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n596\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n597\t computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n608\t    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n609\t\n610\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n611\t        for (size_t j = 0; Propagation)\n621\t// ============================================================================\n622\t\n623\tvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n624\t    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n625\t\n626\t    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n627\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n628\t            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n629\t\n630\t            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n631\t                if (i == j) continue;\n632\t\n633\t                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n634\t\n635\t                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n636\t                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n637\t\n638\t                val_t kij = state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n639\t                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n640\t\n641\t                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n642\t                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n643\t                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n644\t                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n645\t\n646\t                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n647\t                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n648\t            }\n649\t\n650\t            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n651\t            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n652\t        }\n653\t\n654\t        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n655\t            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n656\t        }\n657\t    }\n658\t}\n659\t\n660\t// ============================================================================\n661\t// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n662\t// ============================================================================\n663\t\n664\tvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n665\t    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n666\t\n667\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n668\t        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n669\t        int bestT = 0;\n670\t\n671\t        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n672\t        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n673\t            val_t sum = ZERO;\n674\t\n675\t            for (size_t tt = t; tt < sum += pS * pB;\n679\t            }\n680\t\n681\t            if (sum > maxCorr) {\n682\t                maxCorr = sum;\n683\t                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n684\t            }\n685\t        }\n686\t\n687\t        state.distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n688\t    }\n689\t}\n690\t\n691\t// ============================================================================\n692\t// Validation\n693\t// ============================================================================\n694\t\n695\tbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n696\t    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n697\t\n698\t    // Check that distances are non-negative\n699\t    bool allNonNegative = true;\n700\t    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n701\t    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n702\t    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n703\t    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n704\t\n705\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n706\t        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n707\t        if (d < 0) {\n708\t            allNonNegative = false;\n709\t            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n710\t        }\n711\t        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n712\t            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n713\t            return false;\n714\t        }\n715\t        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n716\t        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n717\t        sumDist += d;\n718\t        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n719\t    }\n720\t\n721\t    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n722\t    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n723\t    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n724\t\n725\t    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n726\t    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n727\t    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n728\t        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n729\t    }\n730\t\n731\t    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n732\t    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n733\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n734\t        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n735\t            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {\n736\t                receivedEnergy++;\n737\t                break;\n738\t            }\n739\t        }\n740\t    }\n741\t\n742\t    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n743\t\n744\t    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n745\t        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n746\t        return false;\n747\t    }\n748\t\n749\t    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n750\t    int nonZeroKij = 0;\n751\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n752\t        if (state.kij[i] > EPSILON) nonZeroKij++;\n753\t    }\n754\t    printf(\"  Non-zero form state.numTriangles));\n757\t\n758\t    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n759\t        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n760\t        return false;\n761\t    }\n762\t\n763\t    if (!allNonNegative) {\n764\t        return false;\n765\t    }\n766\t\n767\t    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n768\t    return true;\n769\t}\n770\t\n771\t// ============================================================================\n772\t// Hash for Verification\n773\t// ============================================================================\n774\t\n775\tuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n776\t    uint64_t hash = 0;\n777\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n778\t        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);\n779\t        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n\n        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n        }\n        return false;\n    });\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\nval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh MT_MATRIX_A : 0u);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        // Phase 3: the remaining indices depend on phase 2 results\n        if (tid >= 2 * (MT_N - MT_M) && tid < MT_N - 1) {\n            uint32_t y = (c[tid] & MT_UPPER_MASK) | (c[tid + 1] & MT_LOWER_MASK);\n            n[tid] = n[tid - (MT_N - MT_M)] ^ (y >> 1) ^ ((y & 1u) ? MT_MATRIX_A : 0u);\n        } else if (tid == MT_N - 1) {\n            uint32_t y = (c[MT_N - 1] & MT_UPPER_MASK) | (n[0] & MT_LOWER_MASK);\n            n[MT_N - 1] = n[MT_M - 1] ^ (y >> 1) ^ ((y & 1u) ? MT_MATRIX_A : 0u);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        if (tid < MT_N) {\n            out[static_cast<size_t>(tw) * MT_N + tid] = mtCanonical(mtTemper(n[tid]));\n            if (tw == snapTwist - 1) state[tid] = n[tid];\n        }\n        cur ^= 1;\n    }\n}\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n__host__ __device__ inline Vec3 pointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, val_t u, val_t v) {\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\n__host__ __device__ inline val_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                                                      const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1,\n                                                      const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return CUDART_INF_F_PLACEHOLDER;\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return CUDART_INF_F_PLACEHOLDER;\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return CUDART_INF_F_PLACEHOLDER;\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated, device side)\n// ============================================================================\n\n__device__ inline bool nodeRayIntersects(const GNode& node, const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) {\n    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n    Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;\n    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};\n    const Vec3 h = node.halfExtent;\n\n    if (fabsf(c.x) > h.x + ad.x) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.y) > h.y + ad.y) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.z) > h.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > h.y * ad.z + h.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > h.z * ad.x + h.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > h.x * ad.y + h.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n__device__ inline bool isRayBlockedDev(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                                       const GNode* __restrict__ nodes,\n                                       const int* __restrict__ nodeTris,\n                                       const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,\n                                       int srcTriIdx, int dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    int stack[40];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;  // the root is entered without a bounding box test\n\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        const GNode& node = nodes[stack[--sp]];\n\n        if (node.triCount > 0) {\n            const int end = node.triStart + node.triCount;\n            for (int k = node.triStart; k < end; ++k) {\n                const int idx = nodeTris[k];\n                if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) continue;\n\n                const Triangle& tri = triangles[idx];\n                val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) return true;\n            }\n        } else {\n            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n                const int ci = node.child[i];\n                if (ci >= 0 && nodeRayIntersects(nodes[ci], from, to)) stack[sp++] = ci;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n__host__ __device__ inline val_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return fmaxf(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Mark the pairs that actually consume random numbers (i.e. are not culled)\n__global__ void cullMaskKernel(uint32_t n, const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,\n                               uint32_t* __restrict__ flags) {\n    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(n) * n;\n    for (size_t p = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x; p < total;\n         p += static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x) {\n        const uint32_t i = static_cast<uint32_t>(p / n);\n        const uint32_t j = static_cast<uint32_t>(p - static_cast<size_t>(i) * n);\n        bool active = (i != j) && !(triangles[i].normal().dot(triangles[j].normal()) > 0.99f);\n        flags[p] = active ? 1u : 0u;\n    }\n}\n\n// One 16-lane group per triangle pair, one lane per visibility ray.\n// kijT is stored transposed (kijT[j * n + i] == Kij(i, j)) for the coalesced\n// gather in the propagation kernel.\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(256) void formFactorKernel(\n    uint32_t n, size_t pairBegin, size_t pairEnd, const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,\n    const GNode* __restrict__ nodes, const int* __restrict__ nodeTris,\n    const uint32_t* __restrict__ rank, const float* __restrict__ rnd, unsigned long long rndBase,\n    float* __restrict__ kijT) {\n    const int lane = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) & 31;\n    const int groupLane = lane & (NUM_RAYS - 1);\n    const int groupBase = lane & ~(NUM_RAYS - 1);\n    const unsigned groupMask = 0xffffu << groupBase;\n\n    const size_t groupsPerBlock = blockDim.x / NUM_RAYS;\n    const size_t stride = groupsPerBlock * gridDim.x;\n    const size_t first = pairBegin + blockIdx.x * groupsPerBlock + threadIdx.x / NUM_RAYS;\n\n    for (size_t p = first; __any_sync(groupMask, p < pairEnd); p += stride) {\n        float contrib = ZERO;\n        uint32_t i = 0, j = 0;\n        bool active = false;\n\n        if (p < pairEnd) {\n            i = static_cast<uint32_t>(p / n);\n            j = static_cast<uint32_t>(p - static_cast<size_t>(i) * n);\n            const Triangle triI = triangles[i];\n            const Triangle triJ = triangles[j];\n\n            active = (i != j) && !(triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f);\n            if (active) {\n                const float* r =\n                    rnd + (static_cast<unsigned long long>(rank[p]) * DRAWS_PER_PAIR - rndBase) +\n                    4 * groupLane;\n\n                const Vec3 pI = pointInTriangle(triI, r[0], r[1]);\n                const Vec3 pJ = pointInTriangle(triJ, r[2], r[3]);\n\n                if (!isRayBlockedDev(pI, pJ, nodes, nodeTris, triangles, static_cast<int>(i),\n                                     static_cast<int>(j))) {\n                    const Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n                    const val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n                    if (distSqr >= EPSILON) {\n                        const val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n                        const val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n                        if (cosPhiI > ZERO && cosPhiJ > ZERO) {\n                            contrib = (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Sequential (bit-exact) accumulation of the NUM_RAYS contributions\n        float kij = ZERO;\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int q = 0; q < NUM_RAYS; ++q) {\n            kij += __shfl_sync(groupMask, contrib, groupBase + q);\n        }\n\n        if (active && groupLane == 0) {\n            kijT[static_cast<size_t>(j) * n + i] = kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\n__global__ void timeDelayKernel(uint32_t n, const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,\n                                int* __restrict__ tau) {\n    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(n) * n;\n    for (size_t p = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x; p < total;\n         p += static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x) {\n        const uint32_t i = static_cast<uint32_t>(p / n);\n        const uint32_t j = static_cast<uint32_t>(p - static_cast<size_t>(i) * n);\n        if (i == j) {\n            tau[p] = 0;\n            continue;\n        }\n        const val_t dist = (triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center()).norm();\n        tau[p] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// One thread per receiver triangle; the j-loop stays sequential so that the\n// summation order matches the reference exactly.\n__global__ void propagateKernel(uint32_t n, int t, const float* __restrict__ kijT,\n                                const int* __restrict__ tau, const float* __restrict__ areas,\n                                const float* __restrict__ rho, const float* __restrict__ radE,\n                                float* __restrict__ radB) {\n    const uint32_t i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= n) return;\n\n    val_t sumB = ZERO;\n    for (uint32_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        // tau is symmetric, so the transposed access reads tau(i, j)\n        const int tauij = tau[static_cast<size_t>(j) * n + i];\n        if (t < tauij) continue;\n\n        const val_t kij = kijT[static_cast<size_t>(j) * n + i];\n        if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        const val_t radJ = radB[static_cast<size_t>(t - tauij) * n + j];\n        if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        sumB += fminf(kij * areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n    }\n\n    radB[static_cast<size_t>(t) * n + i] = rho[i] * sumB + radE[static_cast<size_t>(t) * n + i];\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// One block per triangle, one thread per lag. Ties are resolved towards the\n// smallest lag, reproducing the sequential \"first strictly greater wins\" rule.\n__global__ void crossCorrelationKernel(uint32_t n, int numTimesteps,\n                                       const float* __restrict__ radB, uint32_t sourceIndex,\n                                       int useShared, float* __restrict__ distances) {\n    extern __shared__ float sh[];\n    const uint32_t i = blockIdx.x;\n    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);\n    const int nthreads = static_cast<int>(blockDim.x);\n\n    float* colI = sh;\n    float* colS = sh + numTimesteps;\n\n    if (useShared) {\n        for (int tt = tid; tt < numTimesteps; tt += nthreads) {\n            colI[tt] = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt) * n + i];\n            colS[tt] = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt) * n + sourceIndex];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    float bestVal = ZERO;\n    int bestT = 0;\n\n    for (int t = tid; t < numTimesteps; t += nthreads) {\n        val_t sum = ZERO;\n        if (useShared) {\n            for (int tt = t; tt < numTimesteps; ++tt) sum += colS[tt - t] * colI[tt];\n        } else {\n            for (int tt = t; tt < numTimesteps; ++tt) {\n                const val_t pB = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt) * n + i];\n                const val_t pS = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt - t) * n + sourceIndex];\n                sum += pS * pB;\n            }\n        }\n        if (sum > bestVal) {\n            bestVal = sum;\n            bestT = t;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Block-wide argmax, ties broken towards the smaller lag\n    __shared__ float redVal[1024];\n    __shared__ int redIdx[1024];\n    redVal[tid] = bestVal;\n    redIdx[tid] = bestT;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int s = nthreads / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n        if (tid < s) {\n            const float ov = redVal[tid + s];\n            const int oi = redIdx[tid + s];\n            if (ov > redVal[tid] || (ov == redVal[tid] && oi < redIdx[tid])) {\n                redVal[tid] = ov;\n                redIdx[tid] = oi;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (tid == 0) {\n        distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(redVal[0] > ZERO ? redIdx[0] : 0);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, transposed)\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    // Device state\n    Triangle* d_triangles = nullptr;\n    GNode* d_nodes = nullptr;\n    int* d_nodeTris = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_areas = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_rho = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_kijT = nullptr;\n    int* d_tau = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_radE = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_radB = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_distances = nullptr;\n    uint32_t* d_rank = nullptr;\n    uint32_t* d_mtState = nullptr;\n    float* d_rnd[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n\n    size_t chunkPairs = 0;          // Triangle pairs per random number window\n    cudaStream_t streamCompute = nullptr;\n    cudaStream_t streamRng = nullptr;\n\n    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Initialize matrices\n    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, 0);\n    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n\n    // ---- Device side setup (mirrors the host allocations above) ----\n    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t nn = n * n;\n\n    std::vector<GNode> nodes;\n    std::vector<int> nodeTris;\n    flattenOctree(&state.octree, nodes, nodeTris);\n    if (nodeTris.empty()) nodeTris.push_back(0);\n    printf(\"Flattened octree: %zu nodes, %zu triangle references\\n\", nodes.size(),\n           nodeTris.size());\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreate(&state.streamCompute));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreate(&state.streamRng));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_triangles, n * sizeof(Triangle)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_nodes, nodes.size() * sizeof(GNode)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_nodeTris, nodeTris.size() * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_areas, n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_rho, n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_kijT, nn * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_tau, nn * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_radE, timesteps * n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_radB, timesteps * n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_distances, n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_rank, nn * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_mtState, MT_N * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_triangles, state.triangles.data(), n * sizeof(Triangle),\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_nodes, nodes.data(), nodes.size() * sizeof(GNode),\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_nodeTris, nodeTris.data(), nodeTris.size() * sizeof(int),\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_areas, state.areas.data(), n * sizeof(val_t),\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_rho, state.rho.data(), n * sizeof(val_t),\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_radE, state.radE.data(), timesteps * n * sizeof(val_t),\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.d_radB, 0, timesteps * n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.d_kijT, 0, nn * sizeof(val_t)));\n\n    // Random number window: large enough to keep the GPU busy, small enough to\n    // overlap generation of the next window with the current form factor kernel\n    const size_t maxChunk = 1u << 20;\n    size_t chunk = std::max<size_t>(nn / 8, 1);\n    chunk = std::min(chunk, maxChunk);\n    chunk = std::min(chunk, nn);\n    state.chunkPairs = chunk;\n\n    const size_t rndWords = chunk * DRAWS_PER_PAIR + MT_N;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_rnd[0], rndWords * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_rnd[1], rndWords * sizeof(float)));\n}\n\nvoid releaseSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    cudaFree(state.d_triangles);\n    cudaFree(state.d_nodes);\n    cudaFree(state.d_nodeTris);\n    cudaFree(state.d_areas);\n    cudaFree(state.d_rho);\n    cudaFree(state.d_kijT);\n    cudaFree(state.d_tau);\n    cudaFree(state.d_radE);\n    cudaFree(state.d_radB);\n    cudaFree(state.d_distances);\n    cudaFree(state.d_rank);\n    cudaFree(state.d_mtState);\n    cudaFree(state.d_rnd[0]);\n    cudaFree(state.d_rnd[1]);\n    if (state.streamCompute) cudaStreamDestroy(state.streamCompute);\n    if (state.streamRng) cudaStreamDestroy(state.streamRng);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Exclusive prefix sum over the cull mask (three level scan, in place)\nstatic void exclusiveScan(uint32_t* d_data, size_t count, cudaStream_t stream);\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n\n    const uint32_t n = static_cast<uint32_t>(state.numTriangles);\n    const size_t nn = static_cast<size_t>(n) * n;\n    cudaStream_t sc = state.streamCompute;\n    cudaStream_t sr = state.streamRng;\n\n    // 1) Which pairs consume random draws?\n    {\n        const int block = 256;\n        const int grid = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>((nn + block - 1) / block, 65535));\n        cullMaskKernel<<<grid, block, 0, sc>>>(n, state.d_triangles, state.d_rank);\n    }\n\n    // 2) Rank of every pair within the sequence of non-culled pairs\n    uint32_t lastFlag = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(&lastFlag, state.d_rank + (nn - 1), sizeof(uint32_t),\n                               cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, sc));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(sc));\n    exclusiveScan(state.d_rank, nn, sc);\n\n    uint32_t lastRank = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(&lastRank, state.d_rank + (nn - 1), sizeof(uint32_t),\n                               cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, sc));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(sc));\n    const unsigned long long activePairs = lastRank + lastFlag;\n\n    // 3) Seed the device MT19937 exactly like RandomGenerator(42)\n    {\n        uint32_t hostState[MT_N];\n        mtSeedState(42u, hostState);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(state.d_mtState, hostState, sizeof(hostState),\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, sr));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(sr));\n    }\n\n    // 4) Walk the pair space in windows, generating the matching slice of the\n    //    random stream one window ahead on a separate stream.\n    const size_t chunk = state.chunkPairs;\n    const size_t numChunks = (nn + chunk - 1) / chunk;\n\n    std::vector<uint32_t> chunkRank(numChunks + 1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c <= numChunks; ++c) {\n        const size_t p = std::min(c * chunk, nn);\n        if (p == nn) {\n            chunkRank[c] = static_cast<uint32_t>(activePairs);\n        } else {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(&chunkRank[c], state.d_rank + p, sizeof(uint32_t),\n                                       cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, sc));\n        }\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(sc));\n\n    std::vector<cudaEvent_t> genDone(numChunks), useDone(numChunks);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < numChunks; ++c) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&genDone[c], cudaEventDisableTiming));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&useDone[c], cudaEventDisableTiming));\n    }\n\n    // Word position (within the global stream) that the saved MT state refers to\n    unsigned long long stateWord = 0;\n    std::vector<unsigned long long> windowBase(numChunks);\n\n    auto launchGeneration = [&](size_t c) {\n        const unsigned long long endWord =\n            static_cast<unsigned long long>(chunkRank[c + 1]) * DRAWS_PER_PAIR;\n        windowBase[c] = stateWord;\n        long long needed = static_cast<long long>(endWord - stateWord);\n        const int numTwists = static_cast<int>((needed + MT_N - 1) / MT_N);\n        const int snapTwist = static_cast<int>(needed / MT_N);\n        if (numTwists > 0) {\n            mtGenerateKernel<<<1, 640, 0, sr>>>(state.d_mtState, state.d_rnd[c & 1], numTwists,\n                                                snapTwist);\n        }\n        stateWord += static_cast<unsigned long long>(snapTwist) * MT_N;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(genDone[c], sr));\n    };\n\n    const int block
